name: St Andrews Beach Golf Course
editorNote: Tom Doak designed St Andrews Beach, a fully public 18-hole course in Fingal that welcomes players seven days a week. The Glasshouse now provides a golf shop and café, and the club also lists on-site accommodation. Use the live club calendar to check tee times and current green fees.
